title: Lifted finite coefficient rings and quotient reduction for composition
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension with its fixed valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For each positive integer $n$, use the finite coefficient ring $A_n=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi)^n$ in the standard constant-coefficient universe: when $E$ has universe $u$, put $\widetilde A_n=\operatorname{ULift}^{u+1}(A_n)$ and equip it with the finiteness instance transported along the canonical equivalence $\widetilde A_n\simeq A_n$. For positive integers $m,n$ with $n\le m$, define $\widetilde A_m\to\widetilde A_n$ to be the universe lift of the quotient factor homomorphism induced by the identity of $\mathcal O_E$, using $(\varpi)^m\subseteq(\varpi)^n$. This is the specified coefficient reduction used by the compact-support composition comparisons.
